records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Just checking in a few days after you signed up -- how's it going so far? Happy to jump on and help with anything that's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Ventures!
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for setting up Clearwater Ventures on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero customer replies to three outbound emails (email:eb834254, email:ac97d37f, email:f5f7066e), no tickets, and all three stall reasons present (no project, no invite, no milestone). No signal of engagement, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely though not impossible on an active Pro plan.

draft.subject: A quick hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

I know a new tool can sit untouched during a busy week, so no pressure at all. When you're ready, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project — projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. If your team is more than one person, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to set up that first project with you live and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
